60300.meaning1: may one be successful in this!

60301.meaning1: wearing a full suit; dressed in an inner and outer garment; wearing an under and overgarment; dressed to the nines
60301.commentary: (MNa) sampannanivāsanapāvuraṇo'ti paripuṇṇanivāsanapāvuraṇo, ekaṃ dīghadasaṃ sāṭakaṃ nivattho ekaṃ pāruto'ti attho.

examples.text: potaliyo'pi kho gahapati sampannanivāsanapāvuraṇo chatt'upāhanāhi jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena so vanasaṇḍo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami

60302.meaning1: with perfect precepts; accomplished in morality
60302.commentary: (ANa) sampannapātimokkhā'ti paripuṇṇapātimokkhā. pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā'ti pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlena saṃvutā pihitā upetā hutvā viharatha.

examples.text: sampannasīlā, bhikkhave, viharatha sampannapātimokkhā, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha ācāragocarasampannā aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvino, samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesu.

60303.meaning1: with ripe fruit; with delicious fruit; (comm) with sweet fruit

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre tibbo vanasaṇḍo. tatr'assa rukkho sampannaphalo ca upapannaphalo ca, na c'assu kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni.
sampannāni sassāni yasmiṃ janapade so'yaṃ sampannasasso, janapado.
tesaṃ sampannasīlānaṃ, appamādavihārinaṃ, samma'd'aññā vimuttānaṃ, māro maggaṃ na vindati.
sampannasīlā, bhikkhave, viharatha sampannapātimokkhā, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha ācāragocarasampannā aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvino, samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesu.

sammukhā m'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, manāpadāyī labhate manāpan'ti. manāpaṃ me, bhante, sampannasūkaramaṃsaṃ, taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti. paṭiggahesi bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.

60309.meaning1: excellent pork dish; delicious pork recipe

examples.text: sammukhā m'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, manāpadāyī labhate manāpan'ti. manāpaṃ me, bhante, sampannavarasūkaramaṃsaṃ, taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti. paṭiggahesi bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.

60310.meaning1: perfect in theory and practice; accomplished in understanding and action; having wisdom and ethical conduct

examples.text: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.
passa dhammaṃ durājānaṃ, sampamūḷh'etth'aviddasu, nivutānaṃ tamo hoti, andhakāro apassataṃ.

60312.commentary: (ANa) sampamohaṃ parājayan'ti aññam'aññassa appamattena mukhadosena sampamohañ'ca parājayañ'ca.

examples.text: dubbhāsitaṃ vikkhalitaṃ, sampamohaṃ parājayaṃ, añño'ññass'ābhinandanti, tadariyo katha'n'ācare.
upanītavayo ca dāni'si, sampayāto'si yamassa santike, vāso te n'atthi antarā, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.

60314.meaning1: to proceed; to go on; to continue
60314.commentary: (SNPa) na hi tvaṃ sakkhasi sampayātave'ti… sampādetuṃ na sakkhissasī'ti.

examples.text: atha tvaṃ pavitakkam'āgamā, manasā diṭṭhigatāni cintayanto, dhonena yugaṃ samāgamā, na hi tvaṃ sakkhasi sampayātave'ti.
sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā dhammā. dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā dhammā. adukkham'asukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā dhammā.

60316.meaning1: having a mind associated; with a mind closely connected (with)

examples.text: jāti'pi dukkhā, jarā'pi dukkhā, maraṇam'pi dukkhaṃ, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā'pi dukkhā, appiyehi sampayogo'pi dukkho, piyehi vippayogo'pi dukkho, yam'p'icchaṃ na labhati tam'pi dukkhaṃ, saṅkhittena pañc'upādānakkhandhā dukkhā.

60319.meaning1: due to association; as a result of (their) interaction

60322.grammar: pr, caus of saṃ pa √yuj, intrans (+instr)

examples.text: pakatattassa bhikkhuno uposathaṃ ṭhapeti, pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, savacanīyaṃ karoti, anuvādaṃ paṭṭhapeti, okāsaṃ kāreti, codeti, sāreti, bhikkhūhi sampayojeti, imehi kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭhah'aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno tajjanīyakammaṃ nappaṭippassambhetabbaṃ.

60323.meaning1: having clashed; having quarrelled; having conflicted; having butted heads (with)
60323.commentary: (MNa) sampayojetvā'ti appamattakaṃ vivādaṃ katvā. (MNt) sabrahmacārīhi sampayojetvā'ti sahadhammikehi viheṭhanapayogaṃ katvā, ten'āha vivādaṃ katvā'ti.

examples.text: ye'pi samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā sabrahmacārīhi sampayojetvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattanti te'pi satthu c'eva vaṇṇavādino honti, dhammassa ca vaṇṇavādino honti, saṅghassa ca vaṇṇavādino honti, attagarahino'y'eva honti anaññagarahino
tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhū sampayojesuṃ, tatr'eko bhikkhu accasarā, atha kho so bhikkhu tassa bhikkhuno santike accayaṃ accayato deseti, so bhikkhu nappaṭiggaṇhāti.
diṭṭh'eva dhamme gārayhā, samparāye ca duggati, na ne jāti nivāreti, duggatyā garahāya vā.
piyā su lokasmiṃ kutonidānā, ye c'āpi lobhā vicaranti loke, āsā ca niṭṭhā ca kutonidānā, ye samparāyāya narassa honti.

60327.meaning1: comfort in the future; ease in the next life

examples.text: diṭṭhadhammahit'atthāya, samparāyasukhāya ca, kat'āvakāsā pucchāma, yaṃ kiñci abhipatthitan'ti.
cattāro'me, byagghapajja, dhammā kulaputtassa samparāyahitāya saṃvattanti samparāyasukhāya. katame cattāro?

60328.meaning1: to be felt in the future; experienceable in the next life
60328.commentary: (MNa) samparāyavedanīyan'ti dutiye vā tatiye vā attabhāve vipākadāyakaṃ.

examples.text: puna capar'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, te nigaṇṭhe evaṃ vadāmi, taṃ kiṃ maññath'āvuso nigaṇṭhā, yam'idaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā samparāyavedanīyaṃ hotū'ti labbham'etan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

60329.meaning1: in the next world; related to the next life; of relevance to the hereafter
60329.construction:
saṃ + parā + √i > āy + *a + ika
samparāya + ika

examples.text: tasmā kareyya kalyāṇaṃ, nicayaṃ samparāyikaṃ, puññāni paralokasmiṃ, patiṭṭhā honti pāṇinan'ti.
duve imā cakkhumatā pakāsitā, nibbānadhātū anissitena tādinā, ekā hi dhātu idha diṭṭhadhammikā, saupādisesā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, anupādisesā pana samparāyikā, yamhi nirujjhanti bhavāni sabbaso.

60331.meaning1: drags to and fro; pulls this way and that; drags every which way
60331.meaning2: drags this way and that way

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso dīghalomikaṃ eḷakaṃ lomesu gahetvā ākaḍḍheyya parikaḍḍheyya samparikaḍḍheyya, evam'ev'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi.

60332.meaning1: cuts around; slices all around; carves through

examples.text: tiṇhaṃ govikantanan'ti kho, bhaginiyo, ariyāy'etaṃ paññāya adhivacanaṃ, y'āyaṃ ariyā paññā antarā kilesaṃ antarā saṃyojanaṃ antarā bandhanaṃ sañchindati saṅkantati sampakantati samparikantati.

60333.meaning1: having cut around; having sliced all around; having carved through

examples.text: sañchinditvā saṅkantitvā sampakantitvā samparikantitvā vidhunitvā bāhiraṃ cammakāyaṃ ten'eva cammena taṃ gāviṃ paṭicchādetvā kiñ'c'āpi so evaṃ vadeyya, tath'ev'āyaṃ gāvī saṃyuttā iminā'va cammenā'ti, atha kho sā gāvī visaṃyuttā ten'eva cammenā'ti.
mahāsatto… cirakālasamparicitaṃ nekkhamm'ajjhāsayaṃ upabrūhayamāno mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya pabbajitu'kāmo hutvā puna cintesi, sac'āhaṃ pabbajissāmi, guṇasambhāvanāpākaṭo bhavissāmī'ti.

60336.grammar: pr, caus of saṃ pari √tap, trans (+acc)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ samparitāpeyyuṃ, evam'eva kho, āvuso, adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho.

60337.grammar: pr, caus of saṃ pari √tap, trans (+acc)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso āgaccheyya ādittaṃ tiṇ'ukkaṃ ādāya. so evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ imāya ādittāya tiṇ'ukkāya gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ santāpessāmi samparitāpessāmī'ti.

60338.meaning1: to scorch; to boil; to evaporate
60338.meaningLit: to cause to heat all around

examples.text: gaṅgā hi, bhante, nadī gambhīrā appameyyā. sā na sukarā ādittāya tiṇ'ukkāya santāpetuṃ samparitāpetuṃ, yāva'd'eva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā'ti.
middhī yadā hoti mahagghaso ca, niddāyitā samparivattasāyī, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando.

60344.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of samparivattaka
60344.construction:
saṃ + pari + √vatt + aka + aṃ
samparivattaka + aṃ
60344.commentary: (MNa) na samparivattakan'ti parivattetvā paṭhamam'eva pattapiṭṭhiṃ na dhovati.

examples.text: so na khulukhulukārakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na samparivattakaṃ pattaṃ dhovati, na pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā hatthe dhovati, hatthesu dhotesu patto dhoto hoti, patte dhote hatthā dhotā honti.

60346.meaning1: rolling around in sleep; tossing and turning in sleep

examples.text: middhī yadā hoti mahagghaso ca, niddāyitā samparivattasāyī, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando.

60349.grammar: prp of pass of saṃ pari √vatt, pass, intrans (+instr)
60349.meaning1: being rolled around; being turned over (by)

examples.text: taṃ tattha suvānadoṇiyaṃ suvānapiṇḍam'iva dantamusalehi koṭṭetvā jivhāya samparivattiyamānaṃ jivh'āgge tanupasannakheḷo makkheti, vemajjhato paṭṭhāya bahalakheḷo makkheti, dantakaṭṭhena asampattaṭṭhāne dantagūthako makkheti.

60350.meaning2: causes to turn or roll about

60351.meaning1: having rolled around; having turned over

examples.text: dvattikkhattuṃ kho bhavaṃ gotamo mukhe ālopaṃ samparivattetvā ajjhoharati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā asambhinnā kāyaṃ pavisati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā mukhe avasiṭṭhā hoti, ath'āparaṃ ālopaṃ upanāmeti.

so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, suññ'āgāragato imesaṃ pañc'upādānakkhandhānaṃ ukkujj'āvakujjaṃ samparivattento idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodho'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.

60353.grammar: pr, caus of saṃ pari √var, trans (+acc)

examples.text: mahāyasaṃ samparivārayanti naṃ, sace ca pabbajjam'upeti tādiso, nekkhammachand'ābhirato vicakkhaṇo, devā-manuss'āsura-sakka-rakkhasā.

60356.meaning2: having surrounded, having waited upon, having attended on

examples.text: yaṃ tvaṃ apāyesi bahū manusse, pipāsite ghammani samparete, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmi.

60359.meaning1: shattered to pieces; smashed into bits

examples.text: evañ'hi so, bhante, kakkaṭako sabbehi aḷehi sañchinnehi sambhaggehi sampalibhaggehi abhabbo taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ puna otarituṃ, seyyathā'pi pubbe.

60360.meaning1: shatters to pieces; smashes into bits

examples.text: yaññad'eva hi so, bhante, kakkaṭako aḷaṃ abhininnāmeyya taṃ tadeva te kumārakā vā kumārikā vā kaṭṭhena vā kathalena vā sañchindeyyuṃ sambhañjeyyuṃ sampalibhañjeyyuṃ.

60361.meaning2: blotted out; destroyed; lacerated; lit. completely cleaned
60361.commentary: (SNa) sampalimaṭṭhan'ti dve'pi kaṇṇacchiddāni vinivijjhitvā pathaviyaṃ ākoṭanavasena sampalimaṭṭhaṃ.

examples.text: varaṃ, bhikkhave, tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhu'ndriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

60362.meaning1: enveloped; sheathed; concealed; totally wrapped up

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, matajaṃ nāma āvudhajātaṃ ubhatodhāraṃ pītanisitaṃ. tadassa saṅghāṭiyā sampārutaṃ sampaliveṭhitaṃ. tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa bhikkhuno pabbajjaṃ vadāmi.

60363.commentary: (MNa) sampasāde satī'ti ettha duvidho sampasādo adhimokkhasampasādo ca paṭilābhasampasādo ca.

examples.text: tassa evaṃpaṭipannassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati. sampasāde sati eta'r'ahi vā āneñjaṃ samāpajjati paññāya vā adhimuccati kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā.

60364.synonym: ānanda, pamuda, pamoda, ratha, vitti, hāsa

examples.text: atha kho, bhante, sakko devānam'indo devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sampasādaṃ viditvā imāhi gāthāhi anumodi
tassa mayhaṃ āvuso, etadahosi, idha bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
iti h'idaṃ āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato sammukhā sampasādaṃ pavedesi. tasmā imassa veyyākaraṇassa sampasādanīyaṃ tv'eva adhivacanan'ti.

60376.grammar: pr, pass of sampasāreti, caus, intrans
60376.meaning1: is drawn forward; is inclined towards
60376.commentary: (VISMa) na sampasāriyatī'ti na visarati, abhirativasena na pakkhandatī'ti attho.

examples.text: asubhasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato methunadhammasamāpattiyā cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati upekkhā vā pāṭikulyatā vā saṇṭhāti.

60380.meaning1: is sure (about); is certain (about); is settled (regarding); is confident (about)
60380.meaning2: is pleased, becomes clear, is tranquillized
60380.commentary: (MNa) na sampasīdatī'ti tato, paripuṇṇalakkhaṇo ayan'ti bhagavati pasādaṃ n'āpajjati.

examples.text: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati n'ādhimuccati na sampasīdati, kos'ohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya ca.
yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati n'ādhimuccati na sampasīdati tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
taṃ kissa hetu? tañ'hi so, bhikkhave, saddhāsampadaṃ attani na sampassati, na ca labhati tatonidānaṃ pītipāmojjaṃ. tasmā assaddhassa saddhākathā dukkathā.
mattāsukhapariccāgā, passe ce vipulaṃ sukhaṃ, caje mattāsukhaṃ dhīro, sampassaṃ vipulaṃ sukhaṃ.
kacci pana vo, anuruddhā, samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīr'odakībhūtā aññam'aññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharathā'ti?
imaṃ kho ahaṃ, kevaṭṭa, iddhipāṭihāriye ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno iddhipāṭihāriyena aṭṭīyāmi harāyāmi jigucchāmi
cha, bhikkhave, ānisaṃse sampassamānena alam'eva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā aniccasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ. katame cha?
idh'āvuso, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko. sambodhipakkhikānaṃ, āvuso, dhammānaṃ ayaṃ paṭhamā upanisā bhāvanāya.
kiñ'c'āpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko'ti.

60390.construction:
saṃ + pa + √vañc > vaṅk + a + tā
sampavaṅka + tā
60390.commentary: (MNt) sīl'ādiguṇasampannehi kalyāṇapuggaleh'eva ayanaṃ pavatti kalyāṇasahāyatā. tesu eva cittena c'eva kāyena ca ninnapoṇapabbhārabhāvena pavatti kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, upaḍḍham'idaṃ, bhante, brahmacariyaṃ, yadidaṃ, kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā'ti.

60393.meaning1: who tells about; who teaches; expounder (of)
60393.commentary: (ANa) no ca paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā hotī'ti paraṃ sīlabhāvena na garahati na upavadati.

examples.text: kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhu saṅghe viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyā'ti? yato kho, ānanda, bhikkhu attanā sīlasampanno hoti, no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, bhikkhu saṅghe viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyā'ti.

60396.commentary: (ANa) sampiyen'eva saṃvāsaṃ saṃbandhāya sampavattentī'ti piyo piyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paveṇiyā bandhan'atthaṃ saṃvāsaṃ pavattayanti.

60398.meaning1: (of a smell) exudes; gives off; releases; diffuses
60398.commentary: (MNa) dibbā maññe gandhā sampavantī'ti dibbā mandārapuppha-koviḷāra-pāricchattaka-candanacuṇṇa-gandhā viya samantā pavāyanti, sakkasuyāsan-tusita-nimmānarati-paranimmita-mahābrahmānaṃ otiṇṇaṭṭhānaṃ viya vāyantī-ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: ramaṇīyaṃ, āvuso ānanda, gosiṅgasālavanaṃ, dosinā ratti, sabbaphāliphullā sālā, dibbā, maññe, gandhā sampavanti, kathaṃrūpena, āvuso ānanda, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti?
ime ca sirīsavanā tātā, dibbā gandhā surabhī sampavanti, te sampavāyanti imaṃ vimānaṃ, divā ca ratto ca tamaṃ nihantvā.

60399.commentary: (VVa) te dibbā gandhā evaṃ vāyantā imaṃ vimānaṃ sampavāyanti samma'd'eva gandhaṃ gāhāpenti, na kevalaṃ sampavāyanam'eva, atha kho attano pabhāya tamam'pi nihanti. (PVa) surabhiṃ sampavāyantī'ti samma'd'eva sugandhaṃ vāyati pokkharaṇī'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: ime ca sirīsavanā tātā, dibbā gandhā surabhī sampavanti, te sampavāyanti imaṃ vimānaṃ, divā ca ratto ca tamaṃ nihantvā.
surabhiṃ sampavāyanti, manuññā mālut'eritā, haṃsa-koñc'ābhirudā ca, cakkavakk'ābhikūjitā.
